name: input
title: Input
description: A styled Base UI input for every text-entry type — Field-aware state, invalid and disabled chrome, and the text-entry focus border tint (FOC-3).

meta.whenToUse: Single-line text entry — email, password, search, URL/slug with a domain prefix, numbers, etc.
meta.whenNotToUse: Multi-line text (use a textarea) or choosing from fixed options (use a select/radio).
